question: Can frozen NR-free provide useful reference-free parameter selection beyond gamma?
primary_model: Frozen NR-free: clean reference-group OOF on LOL; existing final on external images.

clahe.meaning: -1 exact input bypass, otherwise original LAB-L CLAHE clip limit, tile8x8

log.meaning: log1p(k*x)/log1p(k); k0 exact identity; float32 RGB
log.original_log: Original max-normalised log is a separate historical control, outside selection grid; its amplitude c cancels.

denoise.meaning: Original gamma API1.5 then float32 RGB bilateral d5 sigmaSpace2 sigmaColor=value/255 BORDER_REFLECT_101; zero exact bypass of filter

data.development: LOL485,234 reference groups, existing5 outer folds; original natural low-light frames only. No new score fitting to parameter outputs.
data.preprocessing: Existing256x256 bilinear float32 pipeline; features quantise truncation to uint8. Same inputs for all selectors. No added noise or synthetic exposure in this initial application study.
data.reuse: All these datasets have previous gamma outcomes. New parameter outcomes are unseen but evidence is exploratory, not a new blind dataset test. LSRW mirror and SICE fusion-reference limitations retained.

selectors: NR-mono product54constraints, classical-only group-train OOF; final released model externally
BrightnessCorrection_lam01 fixed previously selected gamma-trained correction
fits: Only clean OOF NR-mono and classical Linear3/4 are fit. Features, signs, quantiles and normalisation train-only. No model/hyperparameter search. Fixed and brightness-target tuning uses each outer training group, then all LOL for external.
weights: Equal reference-group weights; average files within groups. Train constants minimise group-mean LPIPS; deterministic ties nearest default then smaller value.
decision_ties: Max scores within1e-9; closest declared default then smaller numeric parameter. No reference at decision time.
quality: LPIPS-VGG and DISTS union of selected outputs and controls after choices freeze
analysis: Per dataset/family complete selector table. Paired2000 reference-group bootstrap seed20261030. Report mean,95%CI and differences NR-free minus constant/default/entropy/Linear3/Linear4; lower LPIPS favours NR-free. Test20 primary external NR-free-vs-trainingconstant comparisons(4families x5datasets) with Holm. LOL4 comparisons separate development family. No guarantee of perceptual benefit from proxy alone.
success: Report any effect honestly. Strong bounded application candidate requires improvement>=0.005 LPIPS and adjusted p<0.05 versus training-bestconstant in at least one predeclared family/domain; compare strongest simple selector and independent metrics before any manuscript claim. Failure elsewhere stays visible. No requirement to win every dataset. Tiny effects below0.005 can be valid but are not a strong practical-effect claim.
planned_timing: After evaluations, time all4 search families on one CPU thread including generation/features/selection;3 independent sessions, all retained. No camera-FPS claim.
record: Distribution copy of the plan fixed before the four-family outcomes; original SHA-256 in PUBLIC_EXPORT.json.
